training: calibration_cw.csv; CW lap 2, separate from CW lap 1 reference
method: Midpoint between largest quiet-interval evidence and smallest appearance evidence; quality is the rounded-up maximum finalized new-MM cost from a full calibration-only replay with classification disabled. One pass, no tuning against evaluation counts.
limitations: Legacy opening labels are fallible timing comparators; calibration annotations are not independent field truth.
One evening, one locomotive, one CW excerpt. No held-out-day or CCW calibration.
Overlapping raw samples are averaged in disjoint blocks; integrated contrast is not a statistical probability.
